MINERAL REFERENCE — LAPIS

Concentrated lapis-lazuli pockets, deep mineral blue with subtle pale inclusions, never evenly distributed blue speckles.

Create only the mineral formations and their immediate contact details as a standalone design reference. The completed default_stone.png texture is supplied separately for final composition and must remain unchanged outside mineral-occupied areas. Do not generate, depict, recolor, relight or redesign the host stone. Do not render a full stone tile; concentrate exclusively on the ore deposits.
